name: dsh-tradewatcher
description: dsh-tradewatcher（盯盘）: a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that registers an AIDP-style market dashboard as a global panel through the client Slots service (sidebar.panellist + main key `tradewatcher`) — TopBar index/global/commodity strips with per-card freshness state, hover intraday charts with a caliber bar, embedded cloud map with three-state fallback, grouped watchlist, ledger-driven portfolio groups with market value / float P&L / day P&L, sidebar badge, compact/incognito view modes, JSON backup export/import, and host-side agent tools that carry a data-provenance contract (asOf/stale/source/missing[]) plus a revocable write journal.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run selftest && npm run build
